name: Synap
description: Synap hosts a no-card Qwen coding model with a daily free allowance.
overview: Synap offers qwen3-coder-30b free on its own GPUs without credits. New accounts receive 100,000 tokens and 50 requests per day for the first seven days; thereafter the account page specifies 50,000 tokens and 10 requests per day. Google or email signup; other models and overage use paid credits. Another section of the account page still shows the higher limit without the seven-day qualification.
free_access: No card; Google or email signup
Free model hosted on Synap GPUs
notes: Use qwen3-coder-30b. Limits and availability may change; account page contains an older conflicting quota.
